readiness_baseline_inputs.park_26_recommended_next_step: ROADMAP-03 next phase decision; no cue expansion

ranking_matrix.rationale: Consolidates the operator handoff, launcher docs, validation commands and runtime guidance generated across RELEASE-HANDOFF-01, REAL-WORLD-OPERATOR-UAT-02, UI-USABILITY-POLISH-01, DATA-RUNTIME-HARDEN-01 and PARK-26 into a single operator manual. Pure docs/text work in reports/ and existing doc trees; touches no runtime code, no launchers, no DBs, no terminology data. Highest operator value per risk unit at this state.

Closes the small loop from PACKAGING-LAUNCHER-HARDEN-01: launcher discoverability, dependency-check messages, install instructions, and operator UX of the launch path. Low risk, low validation cost. Best done after the consolidated manual exists so the launch path can reference it.

After G + E, the local operator release becomes the durable shipped artifact. Freezing emits a final release-snapshot report and (optionally) two annotated tags later; it does not block downstream phases. Operator runtime readiness already meets every freeze criterion (blocking_bugs_found=false, launch_readiness_ready=true, runtime_hardening_ready=true, release_handoff_ready=true).

Continued operator UI improvement is valuable but reopens app/main.py and the run/review surface. Should only be reopened after concrete operator-friction signals are recorded by REAL-WORLD-OPERATOR-UAT-03 (a future block), not picked off this audit.

Bigger-corpus validation is high-value for confidence but every step touches private data. Should be designed as its own dedicated planning block first (REAL-CORPUS-VALIDATION-03-SPEC) with privacy gates, aggregate-only outputs and explicit scope-limiting before any execution. Not the next block.
DATA-RUNTIME-HARDEN-01 already closed the immediate runtime/config gaps with hardening_change_needed=false. Marginal value of another data-infra pass is low until operator usage produces new signals.

Terminology/coding integration is the highest medical-value lever long-term, but it crosses licensing and privacy boundaries that no recent block has re-audited. Needs its own ROADMAP-04-style planning block first (CKA-TERM-INTEGRATION-PLAN-01) with explicit license-class table, privacy gates and aggregate-only outputs.

Premature without an explicit v2 trigger. The current local operator release works and meets every readiness invariant. v2 should be opened only after the freeze of v1 (H) and a dedicated V2-ARCHITECTURE-SPEC block carves it into safe sub-blocks.

Defer. The residual-Unknown-reduction track is parked at ~99.99% closed; additional diagnostics would only re-open a parked surface without changing operator outcomes. Reopen only if operator UAT (a later block) produces a new Unknown-related signal.
Explicitly NOT recommended. Reaffirms the standing project posture across DIAG-13..21 and ROADMAP-01..02: cue expansion remains a non-goal.

top_recommendation_rationale: G has the best operator-value-per-risk ratio at this state. Every input to G already exists as a public-safe report; G consolidates them into a single operator manual and a single technical handoff so the next reader/operator can onboard without navigating 25+ reports. It cannot regress runtime behavior, cannot leak private data, and lays the documentation foundation that PACKAGING-DEPLOYMENT-POLISH-03 (E) and FREEZE-LOCAL-OPERATOR-RELEASE (H) will both reference.
alternative_top_recommendation_if_stabil: FREEZE-LOCAL-OPERATOR-RELEASE (H) directly, skipping G and E. Acceptable because every freeze criterion is met today; the trade-off is losing the consolidation gain that G would deliver before the freeze.
why_cue_expansion_not_recommended: Cue expansion has been ruled out across every block from DIAG-13 onward and across all ROADMAP/PARK snapshots. Adding cue packs would re-open the classifier surface that the residual-Unknown track explicitly stopped touching, would expand the regression surface, would create new privacy/data-handling responsibilities and would not improve any operator outcome that is currently failing. The standing posture remains: no cue expansion.
why_residual_unknown_diagnostics_remain_: The 21-record residual Unknown surface (11 Sub-track A + 10 Sub-track B) has been driven through DIAG-13A..21 with default-off metadata, default-off render plan, env-gated Streamlit wiring, env-on aggregate UAT and Streamlit fixture audit. There is no operator-visible signal that re-opening DIAG-22+ would resolve. Park-26 leaves all four parking tag pairs (PARK-20..23) and the additional PARK-24/25/26 snapshots intact. Reopen only if a new operator UAT block surfaces a fresh Unknown-related failure.
